title: Automation acts only on reviewed semantic capabilities (known)
rationale: Bounded detectors/materializers and manual fallback exist in subsystems, but complete current capability coverage has not been reconstructed well enough for a global MATCH/GAP/CONFLICT verdict.
nextAction: Keep UNKNOWN. M3.1 hardens verification-coverage invalidation, manual evidence handling, and evidence-role classification, but it still does not prove exhaustive automation capability coverage or that every automation path is semantically known.
